beats.text: Trump spent days publicly demanding Comey's prosecution. On September twenty-fifth, a grand jury delivered exactly that indictment.

beats.caption: It's not a list, but I think there'll be others. I mean, they're corrupt.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: A reporter asked flat out whether this was justice or a hit list. Trump didn't exactly deny the hit list part.

beats.caption: He's a dirty cop. He's always been a dirty cop. Everybody knew it.
beats.label: via C-SPAN

beats.text: That's the sitting president diagnosing corruption from the White House driveway. Comey, for his part, was not having it.

beats.caption: And I'm innocent. So, let's have a trial.
beats.label: via NBC News

beats.text: Trump wasn't finished either. Asked who is next, he admitted he hopes there will be more.

beats.caption: I hope there are others because you can't let this happen to a country.
beats.label: via C-SPAN
